=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3055-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded directly into HTTPS Git URLs used by clone and related operations.
  WHY: The token is exposed in argv, `/proc`, Git diagnostics, persisted remotes, and workflow logs, violating the credential-free remote contract.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url lines 581-586 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN is embedded in remote URLs returned to Git clone, ls-remote, and push callers.
  WHY: Credentials are exposed through process arguments, diagnostics, and persisted remote configuration.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path lines 241-245 and emit_context lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path guard was deleted, allowing paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, and `.netrc` to be read into model-visible context.
  WHY: Untrusted plan, PR, or issue paths can expose repository credentials and Git metadata.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` limits were removed, leaving caller-supplied path processing unbounded.
  WHY: Thousands of paths can exhaust prompt capacity and, for overflow entries, spawn excessive Semble subprocesses.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_git_subprocess_env (lines 2987-2992) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed without a credential-free replacement.
  WHY: Networked Git operations in `persist-credentials: false` environments either fail authentication or use the unsafe token-in-URL path.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch lines 137-180 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch` assigns a token but runs raw unauthenticated `git ls-remote` and `git push` commands.
  WHY: The ai-memory branch cannot be verified or created in credential-free private-repository checkouts, with failures swallowed by the fail-open path.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:lines 99-115 (parser rejects --provider-base-url), lines 258-261 (base_url hardcoded to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed from the parser while callers still pass it, and generated configuration hardcodes the public OpenRouter URL.
  WHY: Brokered Codex configuration exits with status 2; if it succeeds through another path, it bypasses the local broker and its model, token, and price controls.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:review_blocked_* helper family, previously around lines 947-1346 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `review_blocked_*` approval and successor-issue helper family was deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal decisions cannot detect approvals, publish or consume markers, or prepare successor issues; guarded callers silently fail closed and unguarded callers fail.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:git_with_github_auth was deleted (was at former lines 496-508); scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2014 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The unguarded judge-fix push still calls the deleted `git_with_github_auth` helper.
  WHY: The fix commit is not pushed in `persist-credentials: false` environments, leaving review-blocked retries stuck.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:gh_pr_with_all_comments and _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest lines 732-947 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment payloads were reduced from including `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association` to only `author`, `body`, and `created_at`.
  WHY: Existing consumers lose comment identity and trusted-producer fields, causing deduplication, approval, refusal-marker, and thread-resolution behavior to fail or diverge by data source.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 558-564 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `max_bytes <= 0` check occurs after header content is appended.
  WHY: `max_bytes=0` returns non-empty output instead of the documented empty string; severity disagreement exists, with the highest reported severity being BLOCKER.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 30, 37 (import lines) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError`, blocking the targeted-context contract suite.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 568-620 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Filesystem resolution, stat, and read operations no longer handle `OSError` or deletion races.
  WHY: Missing, unreadable, or concurrently deleted targets can abort prompt assembly instead of producing an omission marker.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:model_provider_broker_start at lines 1737, 3198, 4540; fallback switch at lines 2323-2324 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The implement broker allowlist includes only `MODEL_EDITOR`, while the final attempt can switch to `MODEL_EDITOR_FALLBACK`.
  WHY: The configured capacity fallback is rejected by the broker with an unauthorized-model error.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Artifact cleanup changed from checking `HEAD` and restoring both index and worktree to checking the index and restoring only the worktree.
  WHY: Staged modifications or deletions of `pre_assembled_static.txt` can survive cleanup and be committed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_comments lines 5667-5683 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: A failed envelope extraction after successful selector execution can return the stale success code without envelope output.
  WHY: Downstream conflict healing can treat malformed state as absent and repeatedly redispatch, risking exhaustion of the conflict lifetime cap.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:cmd_select_resolver_retry function (lines 720-727) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Selector failures after comment pagination can cause repeated transient read failures.
  WHY: Repeated failures may consume conflict-heal cycles and terminalize a project.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 1997 — `comment.get("author_id") != producer_id` inside the `extract_orchestrator_refusal_marker` python heredoc | severity=high | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The primary comment schema no longer supplies `author_id`, so trusted refusal markers are rejected.
  WHY: Refusal suppression becomes path-dependent and repeated judge invocations can consume the retry cap.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:test_production_git_urls_do_not_embed_tokens at 51-55; test_networked_git_steps_use_ephemeral_authentication at 99-102 | severity=critical | confidence=5

  WHY: The token-embedded URLs and removed wrapper cause CI assertions to fail.

  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The codex-agent support checkout was reported as continuing to use mutable references while only post-merge jobs validate immutable sources.
